GATE_1_pre_creation.text: R2 regime confirmed active and non-waivable for this title
Medical-clearance and safety chapter is Chapter 1 in the TOC; no technique instruction precedes it
Trademark screen complete and disclosed; subtitle free of outcome/weight-loss/cure promises; protected program names not used as generic
Sub-niche specialist(s) correctly activated (A-J); audience segment assigned
Competitor set is 5-10 current relevant titles, no low-content/outliers
Recommended page target sits inside the proven competitor-derived band (or documented deviation)
Design fingerprint recorded and structurally distinct from prior Pegasus titles
Source list current: relevant guidelines (ACSM/CDC/NIH/discipline bodies) confirmed accessible

GATE_2_per_chapter.text: Every Technique Unit carries its contraindications block BEFORE the instructions
Every technique has seated + standing/supported + adaptive modifications with readiness criteria and stop rules
All prescription variables exact: reps, sets, duration, rest, holds, breath ratio, RPE/HR
Every health claim carries its evidence-hierarchy label; zero diagnosis/cure/weight-loss language
Traditional terminology correct (pinyin/Sanskrit + translation); cultural framing respectful
Every technique has its full step-by-step image sequence (min 3 panels, same demonstrator); a single finished-pose image is a hard failure
Styled opener, shaded technique header bars, tinted callout panels, colored accents present and grayscale-legible
No anti-AI-protocol phrase violations; no filler sections
Chapter references (not repeats) the Chapter 1 screening protocol

GATE_3_post_manuscript.text: Sub-niche accuracy audit: form, terminology, cueing, load prescription, program fidelity
Contraindication completeness audit against current professional guidelines, 100% standard
Every therapeutic assertion qualified and sourced; scope-of-practice intact; no invented credentials or endorsements anywhere
Program chapters use only previously taught techniques; progression logic and safety gates verified
Back matter is title-specific (trackers/checklists match the actual program), not boilerplate
Copyright page carries the health-and-exercise disclaimer

GATE_4_production.text: Native Word TOC, page fields, captions, cross-references updated; Introduction = printed page 1; no folios in front matter
Preface and How to Use each exactly 1 rendered page; conclusion ~1.5 pages
Typography matches the audience decision (13-14 pt for senior/large-print titles); safety callouts grayscale-legible
Page-by-page render: no clipping, overlap, orphaned headings, stretched text, table breakage, missing images, or images covering instructions
Final page count within the approved target band
AI-disclosure and rights records complete per UAPF release governance
